decisions.reason: The manual laser workstation line extends the established laser business and costs little to keep, but it is only mentioned on the website and the newer cabin and flagship laser lines may overlap with it, so it carries some risk of consolidation.
The thermal inkjet printer is close to the core business, still has its own page, and is cheap to maintain alongside consumables revenue, so keeping the option open is clearly worthwhile.
The piezo inkjet printer complements the firm's surface-matching strategy, has stayed visible on its own page, and keeping it adds little cost to the established portfolio.
As the home-page flagship laser line aligned with the firm's Industry 4.0 direction, it is the option the firm is actively exercising rather than abandoning.
The newly launched compact laser cabin is still uncertain in value but cheap to keep and fits the laser expansion, so it is premature to drop it.
The award-winning lubricant printing system opens a sheet-metal niche with positive early signals, so management should keep the option to grow it further.
